🔥 भाईजान Salman Khan ने अपनी आने वाली फिल्म के आलोचकों की बोलती बंद कर दी है!

Hyderabad में Friday को Actor Salman Khan, Chitrangada Singh और Director Apoorva Lakhia अपनी फिल्म Maatrubhumi: May War Rest in Peace के प्रमोशन के लिए पहुंचे थे। 🎬

वहां press conference में Salman Khan से जब trailer की trolling पर सवाल पूछा गया, तो उन्होंने कहा कि "Never judge a book by its cover" और पूरी फिल्म 4 December को सिनेमाघरों में दिखेगी। 💥

फिल्म के song Madirapan और scenes में AI और VFX के इस्तेमाल की चर्चा पर तंज कसते हुए उन्होंने कहा कि लोग देश के जवानों की कहानी पर ध्यान देने के बजाय VFX और AI की बातें कर रहे हैं। 🇮🇳

आलोचकों पर जवाब देते हुए उन्होंने कहा कि अगर मेरी बुराई करके किसी को views, followers या पैसे मिलते हैं, तो God bless them. 🍿

क्या आपको लगता है कि सिर्फ trailer देखकर पूरी फिल्म को जज करना सही है? अपनी राय कमेंट्स में बताओ! 👇

ctx.title: Salman Khan says ‘don't judge a book by its cover’ over criticism for Maatrubhumi trailer; shuts down ‘AI-VFX specialists’
ctx.summary: Apoorva Lakhia's Maatrubhumi will star Salman Khan as a soldier and Chitrangada Singh as his wife. The actors promoted the film in Hyderabad.
ctx.text:
Actors Salman Khan and Chitrangada Singh visited Hyderabad on Friday to promote their upcoming film Maatrubhumi: May War Rest in Peace with Apoorva Lakhia. While there, Salman addressed criticism of the film’s recently released trailer. He also spoke about the speculation surrounding AI use in the film, shutting down these ‘specialists’ for not focusing on the story of a soldier.
At the press conference in Hyderabad, Salman was asked about the trolling after Maatrubhumi’s trailer had received; he said, “If talking badly about my film or me helps them gain views, or followers, or helps them gain fame and make money, I am more than happy. God bless them.”
He also addressed those who thought the whole film was shown in the film, saying, “Those saying this is too long or thinking that we have shown the whole film, we haven’t. I will show you the whole film on December 4. What is it that they say? Never judge a book by its cover? But you have already judged it by its cover. Now what will happen when things flip? God willing, it will. Now, if you found so many points to pick from in a 5-minute trailer, imagine how much will you find in a two and a half hour film.”
After the song Madirapan from Maatrubhumi was released, there were those who believed Salman did not shoot for it, or alleged AI usage. The trailer also faced similar scrutiny. Seemingly addressing the chatter around both, Salman said, “Our film is about the country’s soldiers and their families. And instead of that, you talk about VFX and AI. Who are these people? Where do they come from?”
The actor also added, “Are these people AI specialists? Are they VFX specialists? They think it does not look like Salman Khan shot this scene; it must be someone else. So, for your knowledge, let me tell you that I might not see all this, but my team does.” Salman also pointed out that scenes shot in real locations have been criticised for the supposed use of VFX. He sarcastically thanked the naysayers, asking them not to concentrate on the soldiers or the story they were showing.
Maatrubhumi was initially titled Battle of Galwan and is touted to show the skirmishes between India and China. The film will be released in theatres on December 4.
